title: Yangnyeom Ganjang Scallion-Soy Dipping Sauce
shortDescription: Soy sauce is brightened with scallion, garlic, gochugaru, sesame, and a small amount of sweetener for spooning or dipping.
culturalContext: Yangnyeom ganjang broadly means seasoned soy sauce. Korean versions vary widely by dish and household; this draft is a scallion-forward table sauce, not a claim of one universal formula.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}

instructions.heading: Wash the scallions
instructions.action: Rinse scallions under running water, dry, trim, and finely slice.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Scallions are clean, dry, and evenly sliced.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a clean cutting board for this ready-to-eat sauce.

instructions.heading: Combine the base
instructions.action: Stir soy sauce, water, rice syrup, garlic, and gochugaru until the syrup dissolves.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean utensils that have not touched raw food.

instructions.heading: Add aromatics
instructions.action: Fold in scallions, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
instructions.safetyNote: Declare soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame allergens.

instructions.heading: Rest briefly
instructions.action: Cover and rest in the refrigerator so the flavors combine.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The scallions soften slightly while remaining fresh.

instructions.heading: Portion for service
instructions.action: Spoon only the needed amount into individual clean dipping dishes.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Each diner has a separate portion.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not let utensils used for raw meat contact the master batch.

instructions.heading: Store safely
instructions.action: Cover and immediately return unused uncontaminated sauce to the refrigerator.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The master batch remained clean and chilled.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard any portion contacted by raw meat, seafood, shared eating utensils, or hands.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this is a no-cook dipping and spooning sauce.
visualDonenessCues: Scallion and sesame are evenly distributed
Sauce remains fluid enough for dipping
foodSafetyNotes: Wash and dry scallions under running water before cutting.
Treat the sauce as ready-to-eat and use clean utensils.
Serve in individual portions; discard any portion contaminated by raw food or shared utensils.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; verify labels and prevent cross-contact.

substitutions: Use certified gluten-free tamari only after verifying the complete label.
Sugar may replace rice syrup by taste after test cooking.
ingredientSourcing: Choose fresh, crisp scallions without slime.
Verify soy sauce and sesame product allergen labels.
makeAhead: Prepare up to 1 day ahead and keep covered and refrigerated.
storage: Keep the uncontaminated master batch covered at or below 40°F / 4°C and use within 4 days pending food-safety approval.
reheating: Do not reheat; stir and serve chilled or cool in individual portions.
leftovers: Discard sauce from dipping dishes; retain only uncontaminated refrigerated master sauce.
servingSuggestions: Spoon over rice, tofu, or vegetables.
Serve in individual dishes with grilled foods.

faq.question: Is yangnyeom ganjang always spicy?
faq.answer: No. Chile level and the balance of aromatics vary by household and intended dish.

faq.question: Can dipping sauce be returned to the jar?
faq.answer: No. Discard served portions to avoid cross-contamination.
